LightningComponentBundle.description: Updated LWC Version of the Popular Flow Email Composer

property.name: toAddresses
property.label: To Addresses
property.description: Comma Separated List of Email Addresses

property.name: ccAddresses
property.label: CC Addresses
property.description: Comma Separated List of Email Addresses

property.name: bccAddresses
property.label: BCC Addresses
property.description: Comma Separated List of Email Addresses

property.name: additionalCondition
property.label: Folder ID Filter (Legacy)
property.description: Legacy name for the folder filter — pass a Folder Id to restrict the template list. Prefer the newer 'Folder ID Filter' (folderIdFilter) property in new flows; this one is kept for backwards compatibility.

property.name: folderIdFilter
property.label: Folder ID Filter
property.description: Filter templates by Folder Id (e.g. Unfiled Public Email Templates folder Id). If both this and the legacy 'Folder ID Filter (Legacy)' are set, this one wins.

property.name: maxLimit
property.label: Limit of Email Templates Returned
property.description: Enter a number of Templates to return in the picker

property.name: whatId
property.label: Related Record Id
property.description: Used in merge fields and activity tracking

property.name: whoId
property.label: Contact, Lead or User Id
property.description: Used in merge fields and activity tracking

property.name: transitionOnSend
property.label: Navigate Flow on Send
property.description: When true after successful email send flow will navigate to next screen or finish

property.name: defaultFolderId
property.label: Default Email Template Folder Id
property.description: Pre-selects this folder in the folder picker on load.

property.name: hideFolderPicker
property.label: Hide Folder Picker Only
property.description: Hides just the folder dropdown. Template picker remains visible. Ignored if Hide Template Selection is true.

property.name: hideAttachments
property.label: Hide File Attachment Uploader
property.description: Hides the 'Attach New Files' uploader. Template-provided attachments still display.

property.name: expandCcOnLoad
property.label: Expand CC on Load
property.description: Show the CC field expanded on load.

property.name: expandBccOnLoad
property.label: Expand BCC on Load
property.description: Show the BCC field expanded on load.

property.name: bodyHeight
property.label: Body Editor Starting Height (px)
property.description: Starting height in pixels; users can drag to resize. Defaults to 300.

property.name: toLabel
property.label: To Field Label
property.description: Custom label for the To field. Defaults to 'To'.

property.name: toHelpText
property.label: To Field Help Text
property.description: Tooltip text for the To field.

property.name: ccLabel
property.label: CC Field Label
property.description: Custom label for the CC field. Defaults to 'CC'.

property.name: ccHelpText
property.label: CC Field Help Text
property.description: Tooltip text for the CC field.

property.name: bccLabel
property.label: BCC Field Label
property.description: Custom label for the BCC field. Defaults to 'BCC'.

property.name: bccHelpText
property.label: BCC Field Help Text
property.description: Tooltip text for the BCC field.

property.name: subjectLabel
property.label: Subject Field Label
property.description: Custom label for the Subject field. Defaults to 'Subject'.

property.name: subjectHelpText
property.label: Subject Field Help Text
property.description: Tooltip text for the Subject field.

property.name: bodyLabel
property.label: Body Field Label
property.description: Custom label for the Body field. Defaults to 'Body'.

property.name: bodyHelpText
property.label: Body Field Help Text
property.description: Tooltip text for the Body field.

property.name: folderLabel
property.label: Folder Picker Label
property.description: Custom label for the folder picker. Defaults to 'Select Email Template Folder:'.

property.name: folderHelpText
property.label: Folder Picker Help Text
property.description: Tooltip text for the folder picker.

property.name: templateLabel
property.label: Template Picker Label
property.description: Custom label for the template picker. Defaults to 'Select a Template:'.

property.name: templateHelpText
property.label: Template Picker Help Text
property.description: Tooltip text for the template picker.
